names.description: Enabled victory names; empty selects all. Applies to own and global status.

sections.description: Defaults to our_status, global_status and rankings. Chart history and demographics are on demand.

metrics.description: Empty selects all available metrics. Returned columns use native metric order.

civilizations.description: Disclosed civilization names; empty selects all permitted rows. Filters global status, rankings and charts. Demographics aggregates retain their native scope.

fromTurn.description: Inclusive chart range start; requires charts. Defaults to the last 20 turns ending at toTurn. Continue pages using nextFromTurn.

toTurn.description: Inclusive chart range end, no later than the current turn. Defaults to the current turn; retain requestedToTurn across pages.
